analysis: The trial succeeded with host validation macro HR@10 of 0.6075: Movies_and_TV 0.665, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.620, Electronics 0.430, and CDs_and_Vinyl 0.715. This exceeds the supplied historical uniform-history MultVAE result of 0.5363 by 0.0712. The result supports using the ensemble, but current member-only metrics were not provided, so complementarity and each member’s contribution remain unverified. Electronics remains the weakest category. Allocated GPU time was 482.13 seconds; no test metrics were available.
code_summary: Trains independent per-category MultVAE and SASRec models sequentially on one GPU with seed 42. MultVAE uses unique full-history items with uniform 1/sqrt(K) input weights, binary multinomial reconstruction, and annealed KL regularization; its hidden/latent sizes are 256/64. SASRec uses chronological sequences of length 50, hidden size 50, two causal attention blocks, one head, and positive/negative BCE training. Each member selects checkpoints by validation HR@10, breaking ties with NDCG@10. Inference averages the two candidate rank vectors with equal weights and deterministic candidate-order tie-breaking. The generated predictor reloads both checkpoints, preserves all four dataset routes, and shares training-side preprocessing and fusion code. Artifacts remain trial-local and DATA_DIR uses GAGC_DATA_DIR.
